PHASES

WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 60m "Full Body — Follicular Strength A"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
hip_circles 60 seconds
leg_swings 60 seconds
arm_circles 45 seconds
cat_cow 60 seconds
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
bench_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 60 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 45 seconds
hamstring_stretch 45 seconds
diaphragmatic_breathing 90 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY

shoulder_stretch 45 seconds
scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds

pull_up 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
cable_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
